summary.text: Samra Brouk is a Democratic state senator who represents New York State Senate District 55 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Brouk, who chairs the Senate Mental Health Committee, has served in the Senate since 2021 and is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: Samra Brouk was born in Rochester, New York, and earned a bachelor's degree in psychology from Williams College in 2008.
Her career experience includes fundraising for Chalkbeat, a nonprofit news organization.
Brouk has represented State Senate District 55 since 2021, succeeding Rich Funke (R).
In the 2025-2026 session she chairs the Mental Health Committee and is also assigned to the Health, Agriculture, and Children and Families committees.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Brouk faces Chris Brown (R / Conservative Party).
